title: Expressing cos(pi + x) in Terms of sin x and cos x
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Use the cosine addition formula to express \cos(\pi + x) in terms of \sin x and \cos x.

steps.title: Expand Using the Cosine Addition Formula
steps.explanation: Apply cos(A + B) = cos A cos B - sin A sin B with A = pi and B = x.
steps.why: The cosine sum formula expands the cosine of any two added angles.

steps.title: Evaluate Cosine and Sine at pi
steps.explanation: On the unit circle, the angle pi corresponds to the point (-1, 0).

steps.title: Substitute and Simplify
steps.explanation: Substitute cos pi = -1 and sin pi = 0 to obtain -cos x.
steps.why: Adding pi radians reflects a point on the unit circle through the origin, negating its x-coordinate.
